component.name: LaunchHeim
component.summary: Valheim mod launcher with separate modded instances

description.p: LaunchHeim keeps modded Valheim setups apart. Every instance has its own BepInEx, plugins and configs, and the game folder is never changed, so switching between modpacks takes one click.
Mods come from Thunderstore, Nexus Mods and CurseForge. Dependencies and BepInEx are installed automatically, and Thunderstore mods can be updated in place.
